title: Writable Mapping
claim: Stock richtap_file_mmap checks a 0x4000-byte mapping, derives page protection from current->mm->def_flags | 0xfb, uses FIFO base at state + 0x610, and calls remap_pfn_range for 0x4000 bytes. The mask 0xfb contains the VM_WRITE bit (bit 1).

evidence.observation: Assembly forms protection mask 0xfb, checks length 0x4000, loads FIFO base from state + 0x610 and calls remap_pfn_range with length 0x4000.
Ghidra export is retained, but function-level conclusions here rely on stock assembly because the decompilation is incomplete.
Preserved p-code input identity; no additional claim beyond inspected assembly.
Pinned NX809J kernel source defines VM_READ as 0x00000001 and VM_WRITE as 0x00000002.

inferences: A process with access to this mapping can write the mapped FIFO pages, including node metadata, subject to device-node/open policy.
unknowns: The device-node permissions and the set of processes allowed to mmap are not established by this module evidence.
scope: Richtap shared FIFO used by richtap_update_fifo_data and richtap_rtp_work; offline NX809J stock evidence only.
